intro: ^case files will be delivered once this is over.

^This sentence is meant to test how the animated text looks when you have a lot of words to make sure that things look correct and the text does not wrap infront of you, but is smooth! Hopefully this is a long enough dialogue text to be able to showcase this.

s: ^What did you see on the newspaper?

sister_intro: ^Oh thank God, they said you’d be here. My name's Margaret. I’m in a real bad way, I tell you. I’m sorry to barge in on a private detective like this without an appointment, but I haven’t got much time.
^Charmed. In that case, let’s not waste any time on pleasantries. Tell me about the case.

c-0: ^It’s my sister, see. She’s missing. The cops think I did it. Like I’d hurt her, or something. I swear I didn’t. I need your help, bad. You’ve got to find her and clear my name. The cops will be here for me any minute now.
g-0: ^I'll help, but I don't work for free.

c-1: ^Thanks. I heard you’re the best around. Here - as a token of my appreciation.
^It’s my sister’s - but if you find her, keep it. As a reward. She left it at my place, I was going to return it the night she disappeared, but by the time I got to her place, she was already gone.
c-2: ^I wouldn't expect you to. I've got money. My family's rich, see? Katie doesn’t like to flaunt our money around, but in this case, I’d say it’s worth it, don’tcha think?
^An advance. There’s more where that came from if you find her.

done_questioning: ^Here. I swiped the case file from the police officers. I know that makes me look more guilty, but they already think I did it. What else could I do? You’re my last hope. Please, find my sister.
^They’ll have already noticed that I took the file and are looking for me. We haven’t got a lot of time before they find out where I ran off to. Please, if anyone can solve this, you can.
question_sister: ^When was the last place you saw her?
^Had you noticed anything strange about her recently?
^Know anyone who’d want to hurt her?

c-0: ^A few days before she disappeared. At my place. She left some things there and I was going to return them to her when we went out dancing.
c-1: ^Yeah. She’d been acting real paranoid. Always checking over her shoulder, like someone was following her. And she wouldn’t look in the mirror anymore. It was weird.
c-2: ^Everyone loved Katie. I can't imagine anyone doing anything like this to her.

margaret_loop: ^Anything else you can tell me about your sister?
^How do I know you're really innocent?

c-1: ^Um. No, I think that’s about it. She likes to go out dancing. She’s left handed. Little stuff like that, but I’m not sure how that helps the case.
c-2: ^You really think I’d do that to my own sister and then run straight to a private detective? I guess you’ll just have to take my word for it. But there are things in that case file that just don’t add up.

c-0: ^Well, it’s true that I have the only other key. But I’m telling you, I wasn’t there. So how’d the door get locked? I had my keys the whole time.

case_solved: ^Yes, I know what happened to your sister.
^Wait, no. I need more time to think.
question_sister_loop: ^When was the last place you saw her?
^Had you noticed anything strange about her recently?
^Know anyone who’d want to hurt her?

c-0: ^A few days before she disappeared. At my place. She left some things there and I was going to return them to her when we went out dancing.
c-1: ^Yeah. She’d been acting real paranoid. Always checking over her shoulder, like someone was following her. And she wouldn’t look in the mirror anymore. It was weird.
c-2: ^Everyone loved Katie. I can't imagine anyone doing anything like this to her.

waitress_loop: ^What are you going as for Halloween?
^I read something in the paper about changeling doubles. Know anything about that?

c-1: ^Hmmm. Why don’t I go as a private detective like you? No... A cop? Nah. A photographer, or maybe a professor! No no... Oh! I’ve got it. I’ll be a witch!
c-2:
^Oh yeah, tons. When I was a little girl, my gramma told me that they steal people through the mirror and take their place! Creepy, right?

^You can tell the difference, though. Doubles are always reverse copies of the original. ‘Cause they came from the mirror world. I knew a fella, Ed was his name, who had a mole on one side of his face. Shows up one day and it’s clear over on the other side!

^He said it had always been that way, but I knew better. One o’ them doubles got him! No one ever believed me, though.

the_choice: ^So. You think you’ve got it all figured out. Well then, detective. Which one of us is the real Katie?
final1: ^Please, detective, you’ve got to know that it’s me. I’m the real Katie. Shoot her!
final2: ^Don’t listen to a thing she has to say. You talked to my sister Margaret, right? She must have told you about me.
final3: ^I’m so scared, I just want to go home and see my family. You have to shoot her and put an end to this!
final4: ^She’s been watching me, learning everything about me, for... I don’t even know how long. She even copied my face...
final5: ^She came in through the mirror... I tried to get rid of them all, but I forgot one. Stupid, stupid me. I don’t even remember opening it... just muscle memory, I suppose.
final6: ^No, no, no, this isn’t happening. This isn’t real. Please, shoot her and make it all go away!
dinal1: ^Shoot her, detective! Oh God, please shoot her! She’s trying to keep me here in this place forever!
dinal2: ^This place only exists while she’s alive. She’s keeping us both here! We’ll be stuck here forever unless you shoot her!
dinal3: ^All I wanted to do was go out dancing... I don’t even know how I got mixed up in this anyway.
^Please, get me out of this and you can have anything you want. I’m begging you.
dinal4: ^I kept seeing her move in the mirrors... Oh God, the mirrors. It looked like me, but it wasn’t. It moved on its own. I couldn’t stand it.
dinal5: ^You’ve got to believe me, detective, I’m the real Katie!
dinal6: ^My family’s got money. Please, get me out of this and you can have anything you want. I’m begging you.
dopp_lives: ^I’m alive... I’m... I’m... Real. Ha. Ha ha. And dear detective, why it’s all thanks to you! I have only you to thank for this wonderful gift!
^And now that I’ve been given this taste of life, why, it’s only right to share it. I have friends, you see, who would l o v e to know what this feels like. And now that I’m here...
^I can help them pick a body, too.
katie_lives: ^You did it... Oh thank God, you did it. How did you know? How did you know it was me?
^Well, in any case, i owe you my life. And more, I’m sure Margaret has promised you some sort of reward. What was that thing?
^I’m so relieved. I never thought I’d make it back. I need to find...
